enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping through the hot night with the fan running
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull sheet up. Push sheet down. Turn to right side. Place arm under pillow. Turn to left side. Breathe. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs off bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Spit. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Hang towel. Pick up clothes. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a quick breakfast of toast and tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Take out butter. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Place bread on counter. Pick up knife. Spread butter on bread. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Stand by toaster. Toast pops up. Pick up toast. Place on plate. Open cupboard. Take out tea bag. Place tea bag in mug. Pick up kettle. Fill with water. Place kettle on base. Press switch. Wait for kettle. Kettle boils. Pour water into mug. Add milk. Stir with spoon. Pick up mug. Walk to table. Sit down. Pick up toast. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Sip tea. Put down mug. Take another bite. Finish toast. Drink tea. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing work bag, filling a water bottle and checking the day's program schedule on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open work bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Zip bag. Pick up water bottle. Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out water pitcher. Pour water into bottle. Close fridge. Walk to bedroom. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open schedule app. Scroll through schedule. Read schedule. Lock phone. Place phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk to door.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit office during the morning heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Hold bag on lap. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to office building. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community program logistics and answering partner emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email. Read email. Type reply. Send email. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Open spreadsheet. Update data. Close spreadsheet. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Send invite. Make phone call. Speak on phone. Hang up. Write notes on paper. Type notes on computer. Save notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break in a cool indoor spot near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up. Walk out of office. Walk to café. Enter café. Order food. Pay. Wait. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Leave café. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing program coordination work, running a community workshop and updating participant records
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open workshop materials. Review notes. Walk to workshop room. Set up chairs. Turn on projector. Connect laptop. Open presentation. Greet participants. Start workshop. Speak to group. Point at screen. Answer questions. Distribute handouts. Collect feedback forms. End workshop. Walk back to desk. Open database. Update participant records. Save changes. Close database.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the office in the late afternoon heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Hold bag. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a simple dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open fridge. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close fridge. Place on counter. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Pick up pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Stir. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Serve food. Place plate on table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Repeat. Finish eating. Pick up plate. Walk to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Place plates in dishwasher. Place cups in dishwasher. Place utensils in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower to freshen up after the hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in the air-conditioned living room, watching TV and checking personal messages on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on air conditioner. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Type reply. Send message. Lock phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: brushing teeth and washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the fan on for the warm night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Turn on fan. Close eyes. Pull sheet. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Breathe. Turn to other side. Push sheet away. Turn again. Remain still.
